mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, increasing present value and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates stronger labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which compresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% in a month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) below 1250 thousand units signals a weakening in the residential construction sector, indicating a potential economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1250, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and high consumer spending (RSAFS > 700,000 million) indicates a robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through elevated corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 AND RSAFS > 700000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Reserve cuts the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.2% in a month and annualized CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, the market perceives a stagflation risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.5% AND FEDFUNDS change < -0.2%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.5% AND FEDFUNDS change < -0.2%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (characterized by strong GDP growth and rising inflation), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (characterized by declining industrial production and rising input costs), a drop in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during supply shocks when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is less than 0.03.
